thread:
Alex Chen: Quick note — preparing SDK v12 rollout tomorrow 09:00 PT. Scope: hosted API + dedicated clusters. Canary plan: 10% (10m) -> 50% (20m) -> 100% (15m). Rollback window and owners below.

Maria Singh: Thanks. Can you call out breaking changes for clients? any required header bumps?

Alex Chen: Only one change: clients should send `X-Client-API: sdk-v12` or they'll get a deprecation warning. No schema changes. Changelog: https://go.redwood/changelog/sdk-v12

Sam Ortiz: PR #4737 merged — server-side handler for `X-Client-API` is live in staging. Verified backward compat w/ sdk-v11.

Jen Park: I can own canary rollout and smoke. Ping me 5m before cut. Smoke checklist I'll run:
- health endpoints (GET /health)
- auth token check
- p95 latency < 120ms
- generate end-to-end sample (short prompt)
- embedding length regression check

QA-bot: Preflight tests: 42/45 unit+integration passed. Failing tests are flaky rate-limit tests. Current failure rate 0.4%.

Maria Singh: Rollback plan?

Alex Chen: Rollback steps:
1) Pause traffic routing in router UI -> route back to sdk-v11
2) Trigger rollback job: `deployctl rollback --service=api --to-tag=sdk-v11`
3) Notify customers via status page and #customers
Owners: Jen (canary), Sam (server), Maria (client comms)

deploy-bot: Deploy window scheduled: 2026-03-18 09:00 PT -> 09:50 PT. Canary at 09:00. Link: https://deploys.redwood/in/1912345678

Customer Success: I'll draft an email to the pilot customers explaining header change + SDK release notes. ETA 2h.

Sam Ortiz: Quick note — keep an eye on KV cache hit-rate, we've seen a dip on previous rollouts.

Jen Park: Will monitor metrics dashboard (route: /dash/rollouts/sdk-v12). I'll post updates in this thread during canary. :eyes:

Maria Singh: I'll update the SDK release page and publish migration snippet:
```
// JS
fetch('https://api.redwood.example/generate', {
  headers: { 'X-Client-API': 'sdk-v12', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ...' }
})
```

Alex Chen: Final ask — if you haven't reviewed PR #4742 (client deprecation warnings) please take 1min. Leaving in case we need a hotfix tomorrow.

Jen Park: Got it. I'll start the canary run notes 5m before. Posting check-in timestamps here during rollout.

QA-bot: Canary smoke quick run (simulated): 10/10 success, p95 88ms, error rate 0.05%.

Alex Chen: Great. Thanks everyone. Meeting-free async roll — let's keep comms here. :rocket:
